criteria.requirement: Add deepdiff.reporting.redacted_report(diff,*,redact_paths=(),mask="[已遮蔽]",left_label="left",right_label="right",default_mapping=None) for explicit JSON-tree diff categories. Use actual verbose text representation from text/tree input, preserve category/path/type facts and independent display labels while masking matching values before serialization. Support exact/ancestor paths and native component * / ** wildcards without confusing a literal star key; also traverse coarse parent replacement payloads so child redactions cannot leak. Drop value-bearing multiline diff text when redaction is enabled. Reject unsupported pathless/set categories and invalid labels/paths, apply custom type serializers only after masking, return JSON-safe schema1 report and never mutate original Diff/Delta or source trees.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
